_comment: Edit this file to tune the digest. Every key is optional — anything you delete falls back to the built-in default. You can edit it directly on github.com (pencil icon) and the next run picks it up.
_role_type: intern | new_grad | both  — which sources to pull and which titles to accept
_location: mode: us_only | any. Unrecognised locations are KEPT (better to over-include than silently drop a US role). extra_allow/extra_block take substrings, e.g. 'bay area' or 'belgrade'.
_needs_sponsorship: true = drop roles that explicitly won't sponsor, require U.S. citizenship, or need a security clearance/ITAR. Roles with no sponsorship info (most of them) are KEPT.
_categories: false hides a whole section from the digest
_priority_companies: cosmetic only — these get a star and sort to the top. Never excludes anyone.
_extra_exclude_titles: added to the built-in kill-list; matched at word start, so 'account' also kills 'accounting'
_max_roles_per_issue: GitHub caps an issue body at 65536 chars. Overflow is left unseen and leads the next digest.
